svg.title: massospondylus-golden-gate-150174 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original generalized long-necked sauropodomorph schematic, not the measured Golden Gate skeleton, an embryo or a diagnostic M. carinatus reconstruction. The Hettangian-Sinemurian age envelope does not date this individual exactly to 200 Ma or establish continuous existence.
